title: Kolong Banjir
subject: riders pushing stalled motorbikes through a flooded underpass while a politician's smiling billboard hangs above them
caption: Indonesian heavy alternative rock in the vein of .Feast, riff-driven and political. Two drop-D distorted guitars chugging a stop-start riff; a fuzz bass doubling the low end; hard-hitting live drums with tom fills and crash-heavy choruses; a feedback-laced guitar lead in the bridge. Dense and loud, dry room drums, guitars wide and saturated. Male baritone, half-spoken and sardonic in the verses, shouting a gritty chorus. 132 BPM, D minor. Sardonic, heavy and fed up. No pop-punk bounce, no autotune, no synth pads, no clean ballad breakdown, no screamo.
lyrics:
[Intro - drop-D riff and drums]

[Verse 1]
Air setinggi lutut di kolong jembatan
Motor mati semua, busi kena basah
Abang ojol dorong sambil teriak ke HP-nya
Orderan batal, saldo tinggal dua ribu

[Pre-Chorus]
Di atas kepala kami ada baliho
Bapak berpeci senyum dari tahun lalu

[Chorus]
Dorong, dorong, kolong banjir lagi
Janjinya got dikeruk sebelum musim hujan
Dorong, dorong, sepatu sudah pasrah
Bapak di baliho kok nggak ikut kebasahan

[Verse 2]
Ibu-ibu angkat daster sampai ke paha
Bocah main perahu dari kardus mi instan
Ada yang live di TikTok minta like dan doa
Aku cuma mau sampai kantor sebelum jam sembilan

[Pre-Chorus]
Baliho itu robek sedikit di pojok
Tapi senyumnya awet kayak cat tembok

[Chorus]
Dorong, dorong, kolong banjir lagi
Tahun depan ganti baliho, airnya tetap sama
Dorong, dorong, knalpot minum air
Bapak di baliho, sini turun, bantu dorong juga

[Bridge - feedback guitar and toms]
Lima tahun sekali kalian datang
Bawa kaos, bawa nasi, bawa senyum

[Outro - riff stops dead]
Busi dijemur di atas jok
Nanti sore kita dorong lagi
